name: Essential Black Tee
description: Our core tee. A 240 GSM midweight body with a soft velcro loop panel sewn into the chest. Flat and barely visible when nothing is on it. Ships with the Fuji Rise patch on it.

patchCompatible: Fits every 20 × 20 cm La Vida Stitch patch — the velcro panel is identical on all our tees.
